beats.summary: Dwight throws Jim's cell phone out the window to prevent communication, causing Jim to lose important photos.

evidence.snippet: Dwight (throws Jim's cell phone out of the window): Gah-ah-hah-ha!

beats.summary: Michael and Dwight prepare to prank the Utica branch using silly string, gasoline, and stink bombs while Jim refuses to participate.

evidence.snippet: Jim: No, no absolutely we are not doing this.
